mapreducescript.name: PC | MR | Task to Invoice
mapreducescript.description: Stamps the source Task name onto billable Time in custcol_powercloud_task so NetSuite copies it to the invoice line at billing time.

scriptcustomfield.label: Look Back (Days)
scriptcustomfield.description: Rolling window: only consider time dated within this many days. Defaults to 45 if unset, and is hard-capped at 180 in code so a mis-set value cannot trigger a multi-year scan. Measured baseline: all unbilled billable time spans roughly 28 days.

scriptcustomfield.label: Never Touch Time On Or Before
scriptcustomfield.description: Hard date floor. Time dated on or before this is never modified. Set this to the end date of your last closed accounting period and advance it at each close. Leave blank to rely on the rolling window and the billed filter alone.
